plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0089 · 把模 p 的根比变换成较小模 b 的逆元相位
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0089 · Transport the root ratio modulo p to the inverse phase modulo the smaller b

brief.zh: 将恒等式乘以 bp。由 br≡a mod p 和 p≡a² mod b 得 br+pv−a 同时被 b,p 整除，再用互素。b=1 时 v=0。
brief.en: Multiply by bp. The congruence br≡a mod p and p≡a² mod b imply that br+pv−a is divisible by both b and p. Use coprimality and include v=0 when b=1.
